acikindp.name: Acikind-P Tablets
acikindp.description: Acikind-P is a combination of aceclofenac, an anti-inflammatory pain reliever (NSAID), and paracetamol, which reduces pain and fever. It is used for the relief of pain and inflammation in conditions such as muscle and joint pain, dental pain, backache and osteoarthritis. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
acikindp.usage_dosage: Swallow the tablet whole with water, preferably after food. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
acikindp.safety_info: Take after food to reduce stomach irritation. Avoid in patients with peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, severe heart, liver or kidney disease, or known allergy to NSAIDs/aspirin (including NSAID-induced asthma). Not recommended in the last trimester of pregnancy. Do not take together with other paracetamol- or NSAID-containing medicines. Stop and seek medical help if you notice black stools, vomiting of blood, yellowing of eyes/skin, rash or swelling. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

bonecared3.usage_dosage: Take the contents of one nano shot (5ml) orally, as advised by your doctor – commonly once a week for a limited number of weeks. bonecared3.safety_info: Do not take extra Vitamin D on your own – excess can cause high calcium levels (nausea, vomiting, weakness, increased thirst, frequent urination). Use with caution in kidney disease, kidney stones, sarcoidosis or if you are taking calcium supplements or other Vitamin D products. Get calcium and Vitamin D levels checked as advised. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. This product is a supplement and not a substitute for a balanced diet. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, diabetic or have a medical condition.

gsartan40.name: Gsartan-40 Tablets
gsartan40.description: Gsartan-40 combines telmisartan, an angiotensin receptor blocker, with amlodipine, a calcium channel blocker, to lower high blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
gsartan40.usage_dosage: Swallow the tablet with water at the same time every day, with or without food. Continue even if you feel well, unless your doctor advises otherwise. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
gsartan40.safety_info: Must not be used during pregnancy – inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant. Use with caution in kidney or liver disease, low blood pressure, heart failure and bile duct problems. May cause dizziness, ankle swelling or flushing. Do not stop suddenly without medical advice. Monitor blood pressure regularly. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

healthvit.name: Healthvit
healthvit.description: Healthvit is a multivitamin and multimineral syrup that helps fill nutritional gaps, supports energy, immunity and growth, and is useful during weakness, loss of appetite and recovery from illness. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
healthvit.usage_dosage: Take the quantity advised by your doctor, preferably after food, using the measuring cap.
healthvit.safety_info: Do not exceed the recommended dose. Consult a doctor if you are taking other vitamin or mineral supplements, or have kidney disease. Urine may turn bright yellow due to B-vitamins – this is harmless. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. This product is a supplement and not a substitute for a balanced diet. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, diabetic or have a medical condition.
healthvit.meta_description: Healthvit by GDNT Medicare: Multivitamins & Multimineral Syrup. Pack: 200ml Syrup. Enquire for bulk supply.

hungrycip.name: Hungrycip
hungrycip.description: Hungrycip is an appetite-stimulant syrup. Cyproheptadine, an antihistamine, helps improve appetite and weight gain, while tricholine citrate supports liver function and digestion. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
hungrycip.usage_dosage: Take the quantity advised by your doctor, usually before meals, using the measuring cap. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
hungrycip.safety_info: May cause drowsiness – avoid driving or operating machinery. Not for use in newborns/premature infants, during an asthma attack, or in patients with glaucoma, urinary retention or enlarged prostate. Avoid alcohol. Consult a doctor before use in children. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

lemontem.name: Lemonte-M Tablets
lemontem.description: Lemonte-M combines levocetirizine, an antihistamine, with montelukast, a leukotriene blocker. It is used for allergic rhinitis, sneezing, runny or blocked nose, skin allergies and mild asthma symptoms. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
lemontem.usage_dosage: Swallow the tablet with water, preferably in the evening or at bedtime. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
lemontem.safety_info: May cause drowsiness, dryness of mouth or tiredness – avoid driving or alcohol. Montelukast has been linked with mood or behaviour changes, sleep disturbance or low mood – stop and consult a doctor if these occur. Not meant for sudden asthma attacks. Use with caution in kidney disease. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

livocet5.name: Livocet-5 Tablets
livocet5.description: Livocet-5 contains levocetirizine, a non-sedating antihistamine used to relieve sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes and skin allergies such as hives. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
livocet5.usage_dosage: Swallow one tablet with water once a day, preferably in the evening, unless advised otherwise. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
livocet5.safety_info: May cause mild drowsiness, tiredness or dry mouth – avoid alcohol and driving if affected. Dose needs adjustment in kidney disease. Not recommended in patients with end-stage kidney disease. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

meglocid.name: Meglocid
meglocid.description: Meglocid is an antacid suspension. Magaldrate neutralises excess stomach acid and simethicone relieves trapped gas, giving relief from acidity, heartburn, indigestion and bloating. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
meglocid.usage_dosage: Shake well. Take the quantity advised by your doctor, usually between meals and at bedtime. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
meglocid.safety_info: Use with caution in kidney disease. May cause constipation or loose stools with long-term use. Keep a gap of 2 hours from other medicines. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

metglyva2.name: Metglyva-2 Tablets
metglyva2.description: Metglyva-2 combines glimepiride, which stimulates the pancreas to release insulin, with prolonged-release metformin, which improves the body's response to insulin. It is used to control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
metglyva2.usage_dosage: Swallow the tablet whole (do not crush or chew) with the first main meal of the day or as advised by your doctor. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
metglyva2.safety_info: Can cause low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia) – know the signs (sweating, shakiness, hunger, confusion) and keep a sugar source handy. Do not use in type 1 diabetes, diabetic ketoacidosis, or severe kidney or liver disease. Avoid excess alcohol. Stop and seek medical help for muscle pain, breathing difficulty or severe tiredness (signs of lactic acidosis). Inform your doctor before any scan using contrast dye or surgery. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

montakindl.name: Montakind-L
montakindl.description: Montakind-L is a paediatric syrup that combines levocetirizine and montelukast. It is used for allergic rhinitis, sneezing, runny nose, allergic cough and mild asthma in children. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
montakindl.usage_dosage: Shake well. Give the dose advised by the child's doctor, preferably in the evening, using the measuring cap. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
montakindl.safety_info: May cause drowsiness or irritability. Montelukast may cause mood or behaviour changes or sleep disturbance in some children – consult a doctor immediately if noticed. Not for relief of a sudden asthma attack. Dose depends on the child's age and weight. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

nimoflexp.name: Nimoflex-P Tablets
nimoflexp.description: Nimoflex-P combines nimesulide, an anti-inflammatory pain reliever, with paracetamol. It is used for short-term relief of pain and fever, such as toothache, muscle pain, sprains and post-operative pain. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
nimoflexp.usage_dosage: Swallow the tablet with water after food. Use for the shortest possible duration as advised by your doctor. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
nimoflexp.safety_info: Nimesulide is for short-term use only and is not for children under 12 years. Can affect the liver – stop and seek medical help for yellowing of eyes/skin, dark urine or severe stomach pain. Take after food to reduce stomach irritation. Avoid in patients with peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, severe heart, liver or kidney disease, or known allergy to NSAIDs/aspirin (including NSAID-induced asthma). Not recommended in the last trimester of pregnancy. Do not take together with other paracetamol- or NSAID-containing medicines. Stop and seek medical help if you notice black stools, vomiting of blood, yellowing of eyes/skin, rash or swelling. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

pantadozdsr.name: Pantadoz-DSR Capsules
pantadozdsr.composition: Pantoprazole Gastro-resistant & Domperidone Prolonged-release Capsules IP
pantadozdsr.description: Pantadoz-DSR combines pantoprazole, which reduces stomach acid, with domperidone, which improves stomach emptying and relieves nausea. It is used for acid reflux (GERD), acidity, heartburn and bloating. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
pantadozdsr.usage_dosage: Swallow the capsule whole with water, 30–60 minutes before a meal (preferably before breakfast). Do not open, crush or chew. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
pantadozdsr.safety_info: Domperidone is not recommended in patients with heart rhythm problems, severe liver disease or bleeding in the gut. Long-term PPI use may lower magnesium, calcium or Vitamin B12 levels – follow your doctor's advice. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist, or for black stools, difficulty swallowing or unexplained weight loss. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

pantopain40.name: Pantopain-40
pantopain40.description: Pantopain-40 is a lyophilised powder of pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor. It quickly reduces stomach acid and is used in severe GERD, stomach and duodenal ulcers, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and upper GI bleeding. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
pantopain40.usage_dosage: For intravenous (IV) use only, by a healthcare professional. Reconstitute as directed and administer as prescribed.
pantopain40.safety_info: Do not use if allergic to pantoprazole or other PPIs. Use with caution in liver disease. Prolonged use may lower magnesium and Vitamin B12 levels. May cause headache, diarrhoea or injection-site reactions. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

rabigodsr.usage_dosage: Swallow the capsule whole with water, before a meal (preferably before breakfast). Do not open, crush or chew. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
rabigodsr.safety_info: Domperidone is not recommended in patients with heart rhythm problems, severe liver disease or bleeding in the gut. Long-term PPI use may lower magnesium or Vitamin B12 levels. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or for black stools, difficulty swallowing or unexplained weight loss. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. gdpainmintgel.name: Gd-painmint gel
gdpainmintgel.composition: Diclofenac, Methyl Salicylate, Linseed Oil & Menthol Gel
gdpainmintgel.description: GD-Painmint Gel is a topical pain-relief gel that combines diclofenac, methyl salicylate, linseed oil and menthol. It gives quick, deep-penetrating and long-lasting relief from joint pain, muscle pain, sprains and strains. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
gdpainmintgel.usage_dosage: For external use only. Apply a thin layer to the affected area and massage gently 3–4 times a day, or as directed by your doctor. Wash hands after use.
gdpainmintgel.safety_info: Do not apply to broken, irritated or infected skin, or near the eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes. Do not use with occlusive bandages or heat pads. Avoid if allergic to NSAIDs or aspirin. Stop use and consult a doctor if rash, itching or burning occurs. Avoid in the last trimester of pregnancy. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.

gdcefi200.name: Gdcefi-200
gdcefi200.description: Gdcefi-200 is a dispersible tablet of cefixime, a cephalosporin antibiotic, used for bacterial infections of the throat, ear, chest and urinary tract, as well as typhoid and gastroenteritis. Marketed by GDNT Medicare Private Limited.
gdcefi200.usage_dosage: Disperse the tablet in a little water, stir and swallow, or swallow whole. Complete the full course as prescribed. The dose and duration of treatment must be as advised by a registered medical practitioner. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
gdcefi200.safety_info: Do not use if allergic to cephalosporin or penicillin antibiotics. Use with caution in kidney disease. May cause loose stools, nausea or rash – consult a doctor if diarrhoea is severe or persistent. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking other medicines. This is a prescription (Rx) medicine – use only under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner.
